useWhen: Reconcile a research corpus catalog with source, license and bounded HTTP evidence; use before consuming a public dataset.
avoidWhen: Buying subscriptions, sending leads or collecting personal data without authorization

outputs.receipt: source and license checks plus unmeasured gaps

authority.binding: caller authorization and owner-reviewed target repository policy

compatibilityNote: Hermes storage format only; wildcard versions do not establish installation or runtime qualification. Bind source dependencies and effective permissions in the owning repository.
